entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Magda Cârneci is a poet, essayist, and art historian born in Romania. She took a Ph.D. in art history at Ecole des Hautes Etudes en Sciences Sociales in Paris (1997) and received several international grants in literature and art history. Member of the well-known “generation of the ‘80s” in Romanian literature, of which she was one of the theoreticians, after the Revolution of December 1989 she became actively involved in the political and cultural Romanian scene of the 1990s. In the 2000s, after working as a visiting lecturer at the National Institute of Oriental Languages and Civilizations (INALCO) in Paris, she was the director of the Romanian Cultural Institute in Paris.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in Romanian literature and art history, Magda Cârneci's work contributed to the country's cultural revival after the Revolution of December 1989. Her involvement in the political and cultural scene of the 1990s helped shape Romania's identity and artistic landscape.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a prominent figure in Romanian literature and art history, Magda Cârneci played a key role in shaping the country's cultural scene after the Revolution of December 1989. Her work as director of the Romanian Cultural Institute in Paris helped establish Romania's presence on the international stage.
